title: phyllanthus rhamnoides
intro: Phyllanthus rhamnoides, commonly known as the 'Kerala gooseberry' or 'Chukra', is a plant species belonging to the family Phyllanthaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to improve liver function, reduce inflammation, and support antioxidant activity. The therapeutic actions of P. rhamnoides include its anti-inflammatory, hepatoprotective, and antiviral properties, which may help in the management of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its potential health benefits.
